- [IDAT.1.4] **Single ownership.** Every heap allocation has
  exactly one owner at any time. Ownership transfer
  happens only at explicitly-named APIs
  (e.g. `ds_engine_take_fact(engine, fact)`). Default
  is "caller keeps ownership of its arguments; callee
  keeps ownership of its returns." Borrows (non-owning
  pointers) are documented per-function.
